what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Bangladesh in all host countries combined: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 92441 asylum seekers from Bangladesh.
Italy hosts the largest share, 40.2%, followed by Canada, the United States and South Africa.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Bangladesh with the PBCP and PBCP-J in 2005 and 2006, and with the Islamic State group in 2016 and 2017.
The fact pack does not link these conflicts to the asylum figures.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 3322 asylum seekers.
The figure reached its highest point, 108131, at the end of 2024, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2017 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals of asylum seekers summed over every host country; refugees from Bangladesh are counted separately.
